I am a woman with little land and no schooling, so I must be careful with every birr I spend. My maize plot is very small, only a tiny piece, so I will put the manure from my animals on it because that costs me nothing. I cannot afford much chemical fertilizer or hybrid seed from the market, and we have no irrigation here — we wait for the rains like everyone in our kebele. My children and I will do the weeding and harvesting ourselves; maybe I will ask a neighbor for one or two days of help when the work is heavy.
